pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Morphy Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 used a ...b6 and ...Nb7-c5 manoeuvre instead of the usual ...Nxc4; plan 1 ignored the pin with Qe2; plan 4 (queenside castling) was unsupported. Overview and plans 1, 3 and 4 rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Morphy Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White castle queenside with the b1-knight and c1-bishop still at home, and plan 2 had Black attacking a king that had castled long. Plans 1-3 rewritten (the f3-knight is attacked; 10.Nfd2 is the Yankovich). British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights Defence:Morphy Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 named an a5-knight already exchanged on c4; plan 1 played f3 with the knight on f3; plan 3 claimed an open d-file. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Morphy, Polerio, 6...c6
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed d3-d4 through the bishop on d3; plan 1 claimed an open c-file. Rewritten; overview notes that Bd3 blocks the d-pawn. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights:Colman Defence
pages.notes: Plan 2 played Be3 with the d2-pawn blocking the c1-bishop; rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights:Colman's Defence
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Black expand with ...a6 and ...b5 with no b-pawn; overview called the a5-knight powerful. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Knorre Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the knight ...Nb7-d8-f7 onto Black's own f7-pawn; plan 4 had White castling queenside. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Polerio Defense, Göring Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 had White dislodging its own e5-knight; overview missed that 10...Qc7 attacks it (reviewer rejected the first wording that White must support it; fixed and accepted). Plans 1, 2 and 4 rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Polerio Defense, Suhle Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Be6 and ...Re8, which parsed badly and missed the e-pawn; overview was generic. Rewritten around 8...h6 driving back the knight. British spelling.

pages.name: Italian Game: Two Knights Defense, Steinitz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...d4 with no black d-pawn and both ...Bc5 and ...Bd6; plan 2 sent the knight to f2, where White's pawn stands. Rewritten. British spelling.
